Low-rise everything strutting past like it's 2003 again? Absolutely check. This is the kind of night that turns into a story you're still telling your friends weeks later. Trust her — this is one you absolutely don't wanna miss. Mark it, set a reminder, tell your group chat. Thursday night, the Lounge is a time machine and everyone's invited to relive the era. 💫
